pp2.5:1.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo ārambhati ca vippaṭisārī ca hoti tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti so evamassa vacanīyo
pp2.5:1.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā pavaḍḍhanti
pp2.5:1.3: sādhu vatāyasmā ārambhaje āsave pahāya vippaṭisāraje āsave paṭivinodetvā cittaṃ paññañca bhāvetu
pp2.5:1.4: evamāyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatīti.
pp2.5:2.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo ārambhati na vippaṭisārī hoti tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti so evamassa vacanīyo
pp2.5:2.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā nappavaḍḍhanti
pp2.5:2.3: sādhu vatāyasmā ārambhaje āsave pahāya cittaṃ paññañca bhāvetu
pp2.5:2.4: evamāyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatīti.
pp2.5:3.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo na ārambhati vippaṭisārī hoti tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti so evamassa vacanīyo
pp2.5:3.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā na saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā pavaḍḍhanti
pp2.5:3.3: sādhu vatāyasmā vippaṭisāraje āsave paṭivinodetvā cittaṃ paññañca bhāvetu
pp2.5:3.4: evamāyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatīti.
pp2.5:4.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo na ārambhati na vippaṭisārī hoti tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti so evamassa vacanīyo
pp2.5:4.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā na saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā nappavaḍḍhanti
pp2.5:4.4: evamāyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatīti.
pp2.5:5.1: ime cattāro puggalā amunā pañcamena puggalena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evamanusāsiyamānā anupubbena āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇanti.
pp2.5:6.2: idhekacco puggalo yassa puggalassa deti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tassa evaṃ hoti
pp2.5:6.3: ahaṃ dammi ayaṃ pana paṭiggaṇhātīti tamenaṃ datvā avajānāti
pp2.5:7.2: idhekacco puggalo yena puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasati dve vā tīṇi vā vassāni tamenaṃ saṃvāsena avajānāti
pp2.5:8.2: idhekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne khippaññeva adhimuccitā hoti
pp2.5:9.2: idhekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhatti ittarapemo ittarappasādo
pp2.5:10.2: idhekacco puggalo kusalākusale dhamme na jānāti sāvajjānavajje dhamme na jānāti hīnappaṇīte dhamme na jānāti kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme na jānāti
pp2.5:11.3: idhekacco yodhājīvo rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata
pp2.5:11.5: ayaṃ paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:12.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata
pp2.5:12.3: ayaṃ dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:13.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ apica kho ussādanaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata
pp2.5:13.3: ayaṃ tatiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:14.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ apica kho sampahāre haññati byāpajjati
pp2.5:14.3: ayaṃ catuttho yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:15.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ
pp2.5:15.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati
pp2.5:15.4: ayaṃ pañcamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:15.5: ime pañca yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:16.1: evameva pañcime yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:17.1: idhekacco bhikkhu rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
pp2.5:17.4: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatāti
pp2.5:17.5: so taṃ sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
pp2.5:18.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.5:18.3: ayaṃ paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:19.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
pp2.5:19.3: idha bhikkhu na heva kho suṇāti
pp2.5:19.4: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatāti apica kho sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ
pp2.5:19.5: so taṃ disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
pp2.5:20.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ apica kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.5:20.3: ayaṃ dutiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:21.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ apica kho ussādanaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
pp2.5:21.3: idha bhikkhakha araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati ullapati ujjagghati upphaṇḍeti
pp2.5:21.4: so mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjagghiyamāno upphaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetata sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
pp2.5:22.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ apica kho ussādanaññeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otaritata tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.5:22.3: ayaṃ tatiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:23.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ apica kho sampahāre haññati byāpajjati.
pp2.5:23.3: idha bhikkhakha araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati
pp2.5:23.4: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati
pp2.5:24.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ apica kho sampahāre haññati byāpajjati tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.5:24.3: ayaṃ catuttho yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:25.1: puna caparaṃ idhekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ
pp2.5:25.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
pp2.5:25.4: idha bhikkhakha araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati.
pp2.5:25.5: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno viniveṭhetvā vinimocetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
pp2.5:26.1: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
pp2.5:26.2: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujaja kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
pp2.5:26.3: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti
pp2.5:26.4: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
pp2.5:26.5: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti
pp2.5:26.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
pp2.5:26.7: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
pp2.5:27.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
pp2.5:28.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
pp2.5:28.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
pp2.5:28.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
pp2.5:29.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
pp2.5:29.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
pp2.5:29.5: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.5:29.7: ayaṃ pañcamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:30.1: ime pañca yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:31.2: mandattā momūhattā piṇḍapātiko hoti pāpiccho icchāpakato piṇḍapātiko hoti ummādā cittavikkhepā piṇḍapātiko hoti vaṇṇitaṃ buddhehi buddhasāvakehīti piṇḍapātiko hoti apica appicchaṃyeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃyeva nissāya sallekhaṃyeva nissāya idamatthitaṃyeva nissāya piṇḍapātiko hoti.
pp2.5:31.3: tatra yvāyaṃ piṇḍapātiko appicchaṃyeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃyeva nissāya sallekhaṃyeva nissāya idamatthitaṃyeva nissāya piṇḍapātiko ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ piṇḍapātikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
pp2.5:32.1: seyyathāpi nāma gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo sappimaṇḍaṃ tattha aggamakkhāyati

pp2.5:34.3: tatra yvāyaṃ sosāniko appicchaṃyeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃyeva nissāya sallekhaṃyeva nissāya idamatthitaṃyeva nissāya sosāniko ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sosānikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
pp2.5:35.1: seyyathāpi nāma gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo sappimaṇḍaṃ tattha aggamakkhāyati
pp2.5:35.2: evameva yvāyaṃ sosāniko appicchaṃyeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃyeva nissāya sallekhaṃyeva nissāya idamatthitaṃyeva nissāya sosāniko hoti ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sosānikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
